overview.text: The Eastern Montpellier Snake is a large, mildly venomous, rear-fanged snake of the eastern Mediterranean, the Middle East and North Africa.

identification.text: Often has narrow pale stripes along the body; unlike the western Montpellier Snake, males have no dark 'saddle'.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: From the eastern Adriatic coast through the Balkans, Greece, Turkey and Cyprus to the Caucasus, Iraq, Iran and Arabia, and across North Africa from Morocco to Egypt.
